sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
Heard Mr. Satish Solanki, learned counsel for the applicant and the learned A.G.A. for the State.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant seeking direction to the court below to decide the Case No. 233 of 2019 which is newly registered as Misc. Case No.
543/12/18 Manisha Vs. Sabir and others, under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Hathras, District Hathras within stipulated period.

sentences.text:
Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, preferably Manisha vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 17 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34659509/
1 within a period of one year from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.
